faqs.answer:
To verify a certificate:
1. Locate the QR code on the certificate
2. Scan the QR code using any QR scanner app
3. Or visit our certificate verification page
4. Enter the unique verification code from the certificate
5. The system will show:
   - Student name
   - Course/Event/Internship name
   - Issue date
   - Expiry date (if applicable)
   - Status (Active/Revoked/Expired)
6. The certificate is verified if all details match
7. Forged certificates will fail verification
8. Contact support if you have issues
followup: My certificate isn't verifying

faqs.notes: Digital certificates remain valid unless revoked. Certificates cannot be altered or forged. Duplicate certificates can be requested subject to a fee.
